datasetName: Ecological Assessment District Lots 21 and 22, Galiano Island BC
occurrenceRemarks: Approximately 3000 plants with approximately 50% flowering in area overlooking ocean. Associates include: Sedum sp., Rosa sp., Acer macrophyllum, Quercus garryana, Selaginella sp., and purple Lonicera. Site has layer of damp soil (2 inches deep) over conglomerate rock with low floor litter and open exposure. Area consists of horizontal ledges among a 70% slope with a south aspect (A. Hawryzki, pers. comm. 1996)
